```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>",
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(neurogeo)
```

## 基础背景

spatial support 是一个值所代表的面积、体积、vertex 集合或其他空间范围。
从 vertex 变为 region 不是改名，而是使用 target-by-source 稀疏算子 \(A\)
进行传递。extensive 变量可按 \(Ax\) 守恒分配；intensive 变量需要用转移后的
support 对加权分子归一化。

## 构造 support map

```{r}
source <- ngeo_point(
  cbind(x = 1:4, y = 0),
  values = cbind(intensity = c(10, 20, 30, 40)),
  measures = ngeo_measure(support_behavior = "intensive")
)
target <- ngeo_parcellation(
  data.frame(region_id = c("A", "B")), support_size = c(3, 3)
)
support_map <- ngeo_support_map(
  source, target,
  operator = c("A", "A", "B", "B"),
  source_support = c(1, 2, 1, 2)
)
regional <- aggregate_to(source, target, support_map)
regional$values
```

## 诊断与可视化

```{r diagnostic, fig.alt="每个源元素的 support membership sum 直方图"}
ngeo_support_diagnostics(support_map)
plot(support_map, type = "membership", col = "#26a69a", border = "white")
```

crisp complete map 中每个 source column 的 membership sum 应为 1。重叠算子
若要守恒，必须显式说明 normalization。

## 比较两个 atlas

```{r}
target2 <- ngeo_parcellation(
  data.frame(region_id = c("C", "D")), support_size = c(3, 3)
)
support_map2 <- ngeo_support_map(
  source, target2,
  operator = c("C", "D", "D", "C"),
  source_support = c(1, 2, 1, 2)
)
overlap <- as.matrix(
  ngeo_atlas_overlap(support_map, support_map2, distance_method = "dice")
)
overlap
```

Dice overlap 描述两个 support 的物理重叠，不表示一个 atlas 可以无误差地重建
另一个 atlas。
